reviews.review_text:
Richa bhatt
4 contributions

Good
Sep 2026 • Friends
Had a really lovely experience here! Being an Indian in Vietnam, finding good vegetarian Indian food can be a little difficult, so this place was honestly a lifesaver. 😄
The food was fresh, flavorful and tasted very authentic. Everything was prepared really well, and the staff was warm, polite and welcoming. It felt so good to have a proper Indian meal while travelling.
Definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for authentic Indian food in Vietnam, especially vegetarians.
